endpoints.storage_mechanism: Multer Disk Storage on App Server (`backend/uploads/zoniraz/`)
endpoints.current_vps_sync_status: Local App Staging (Saved locally in uploads/zoniraz/; requires VPS sync handler or direct upload to VPS)

architecture_summary.app_server_role: Receives multipart/base64 uploads, generates collision-safe filename, returns https://media.zoniraz.com/uploads/...
